## Summary of Changes

A clear and concise description of what changes were made and why.

---

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

---

## Verification & Testing

Explain how the changes were tested:
- [ ] Ran `pnpm test` (Backend pytest suite passed)
- [ ] Ran `pnpm --prefix frontend build` (Frontend build passed)
- [ ] Manual testing / dev server verification (`pnpm run dev`)

---

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding standards.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have updated documentation where necessary.
- [ ] No fake/invented financial data was added to customer interfaces.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials were committed.
